description: The offline data backbone: download + commit every flag PNG and the world map, author the full Kotlin data layer (Countries 199, US 56, Canada 13) with keys that exactly match the asset filenames, add the repository, and implement + unit-test the dependency-free fuzzy matcher. Depends on FEAT-001 (needs the module/source roots and asset dir). Blocks FEAT-003 (UI consumes repository + matcher + assets).
steps: Write scripts/download_assets.ps1: set $ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; define the country alpha-2 list (199 incl. tw, xk, va, ps), the US list (us-<postal> x51 incl. us-dc, plus territories pr/gu/vi/as/mp), and the Canada map of key->Wikimedia filename (ca-ab Flag_of_Alberta, ca-bc Flag_of_British_Columbia, ca-mb Flag_of_Manitoba, ca-nb Flag_of_New_Brunswick, ca-nl Flag_of_Newfoundland_and_Labrador, ca-ns Flag_of_Nova_Scotia, ca-on Flag_of_Ontario, ca-pe Flag_of_Prince_Edward_Island, ca-qc Flag_of_Quebec, ca-sk Flag_of_Saskatchewan, ca-yt Flag_of_Yukon, ca-nt Flag_of_the_Northwest_Territories, ca-nu Flag_of_Nunavut). The complete country code list is in .agents/tasks/plan.md step 3 - copy it verbatim. For each: download to app/src/main/assets/flags/<key>.png via Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing, verify the file is non-empty and starts with PNG magic 0x89 0x50 0x4E 0x47, delete + record any failure. Country/US use https://flagcdn.com/w320/<code>.png; Canada uses https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/<filename>.svg?width=320. Finally download the world map https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/BlankMap-World.svg?width=2048 to app/src/main/assets/world_map.png and PNG-verify it. Print total succeeded, total failed, and the failed list.

RUN scripts/download_assets.ps1 on this dev machine. For any country/subdivision that 404s on flagcdn, fall back to the Wikimedia Special:FilePath/Flag_of_<Name>.svg?width=320 form and re-verify. Confirm ZERO remaining failures.

Author app/src/main/java/com/greenbluefish/flagmaster/data/FlagEntry.kt: enum class Category { COUNTRY, US, CANADA } and data class FlagEntry(val key:String, val name:String, val category:Category, val region:String, val capital:String, val lat:Double, val lon:Double, val funFact:String).

Author CountryData.kt (object with the 199 COUNTRY FlagEntry values), UsData.kt (56 US entries: 50 states + us-dc + territories pr/gu/vi/as/mp), CanadaData.kt (13 entries). Every entry's key MUST equal an existing assets/flags/<key>.png; capital, region, lat, lon must be real/accurate (capital or centroid); funFact must be a genuine one-line fact, never a placeholder.
Author FlagRepository.kt: object exposing all(): List<FlagEntry> (country+us+canada), byCategories(set: Set<Category>): List<FlagEntry>, find(name): FlagEntry? and/or byKey(key): FlagEntry?.

Author quiz/FuzzyMatcher.kt: fun closest(query: String, pool: List<FlagEntry>): FlagEntry? that lowercases+trims, returns null for blank query, and ranks by prefix match (startsWith; shortest name wins), then substring (contains), then minimum Levenshtein distance. Pure Kotlin, no dependencies.

Add app/src/test/java/com/greenbluefish/flagmaster/FuzzyMatcherTest.kt (JUnit4): blank query returns null; 'unit' over all countries returns a United* entry; a US-only pool never returns a COUNTRY entry (selected-pool isolation); typo 'califonia' over US pool returns California.
acceptance_criteria: app/src/main/assets/flags/ contains one valid PNG per authored entry (~268) with ZERO download failures; app/src/main/assets/world_map.png exists, > 100KB, PNG magic bytes.
Data counts: CountryData has 199 entries, UsData 56, CanadaData 13.
Every key in the data layer has a matching assets/flags/<key>.png and every PNG has a matching data entry (no orphans, no missing) - proven by a PowerShell set-difference check.
Running ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest in CI passes FuzzyMatcherTest, including the US-only-pool-never-returns-a-country assertion.
verification: PowerShell: (Get-ChildItem app/src/main/assets/flags/*.png).Count equals the authored entry total; assert each file starts with 0x89 0x50 0x4E 0x47.
PowerShell: extract every key="..." from data/*.kt, extract every flags/*.png basename, and assert the two sets are equal (print any only-in-data or only-in-assets).
PowerShell: Select-String -Pattern 'TODO|lorem|placeholder|TBD' over data/*.kt returns nothing.
CI: ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest passes (local JDK is Java 8 so this runs in GitHub Actions, wired up in FEAT-004).
findings: Assets: 266 flag PNGs downloaded (all verified PNG magic 0x89504E47, zero failures) + world_map.png (380202 bytes, >100KB, PNG magic). Fallbacks used: (1) us-dc 404s on flagcdn -> fetched from Wikimedia Special:FilePath/Flag_of_Washington,_D.C..svg?width=320; (2) all 13 Canada flags from Wikimedia Special:FilePath Flag_of_<Name>.svg?width=320 (flagcdn has no ca-<code>). All country/US-state/US-territory flags came straight from flagcdn.com/w320. COUNT RECONCILIATION: the authoritative verbatim country list in plan.md step 3 contains exactly 197 unique alpha-2 codes (193 UN members + 2 observers va/ps + widely-recognized xk/tw = complete 'UN + widely recognized' set), not the ~199 estimate in this feature's acceptance text; CountryData matches the verbatim list exactly. Final counts: CountryData=197, UsData=56, CanadaData=13 => 266 entries, and the data-key set equals the flags-PNG set exactly (0 orphans, 0 missing, all unique). No placeholder text (TODO/lorem/placeholder/TBD) in data files. Note: 'Georgia' appears once as a country (ge) and once as a US state (us-ga); this is an intentional real-world name collision, disambiguated by category-scoped quiz pools. FuzzyMatcher is dependency-free (prefix->substring->Levenshtein, blank=>null, selected-pool only); FuzzyMatcherTest asserts blank=>null, empty-pool=>null, 'unit'=>United*, US-only-pool-never-returns-a-COUNTRY, and typo 'califonia'=>California. Unit test runs in CI (local JDK is Java 8).
